name: UNDERCOVER
title: Undercover
blurb: One word, one impostor, one phone passed round the table.
description: Everyone gets a secret word — except the impostors, who get one that is nearly right. Describe it, argue, vote. Pick from 14 topics and 750 word pairs, easy or hard; scores carry from hand to hand. Played on one phone passed round the table, so there is nothing to connect.
author: lokeshmohanty
